title: inspire.emanation-plan/2
description: What emanate-plan.sh prints on stdout: a plan on exits 0 and 1, a refusal on exit 4. Stdout is empty on every other exit.

unitKind.description: Derive's five unit kinds — the complete set.

population.description: Entities only; null on every other kind. Plan decides nothing with it.

findingCode.description: Codes reported when a plan WAS computed. Disjoint from refusalCode.

refusalCode.description: Codes reported when nothing was planned. Disjoint from findingCode.

scope.description: The --scope paths, LC_ALL=C sorted and deduplicated.

ready.description: false when at least one finding is severity error (exit 1).

floor.description: The critical path's depth; equals waves.length.

deliverable_waves.description: min(effective floor, ceiling); the effective floor is goal.floor when a goal was named.

realized.description: Frontier-eligible units already realized on this branch. Bare ids: these are not work items and appear in no wave.

realized_all.description: Every frontier-eligible unit is realized: floor 0, waves []. 'Nothing left to build', distinct from PR-12's 'nothing to build'.

units.description: The goal's remaining closure: its dependencies plus the screens that navigate to it. Not waves-shaped.

waves.description: Ascending by wave. Holds only what this run will build.

wave.description: 1-based and contiguous. Every unit here has all its in-frontier ordering dependencies in a strictly lower wave, so one wave's units may be built in parallel.

id.description: Dotted and unique across the plan — the join key for requires[].id, realized[], goal.units[], reemanate.units[] and findings[].unit. Not a display name: a pattern 'list' and a screen 'samples.list' coexist.

path.description: Repo-root-relative. Passed unchanged to emanate-derive.sh and emanate-gate.sh.

module.description: null for the two catalog kinds, which have none.

surface.description: The surface a split screens tree puts a screen under; null for every other kind and for the flat suite-of-one shape.

profiles.description: The resolved set the unit is emanated under: its framework profile, that framework's language, and any declared layer: language profile.

requires.description: Derive's edge set verbatim. A target satisfied out of band — stable, realized, or out of scope — has no unit record anywhere in this document.

claims.description: Claim count from the derived contract; 0 for a refused unit. The sizing signal an orchestrator budgets on.

ordering.description: false is a deferred reference, which gates readiness but never orders a wave. true is not a promise of an earlier wave either: navigation and self edges are dropped from the ordering too.

target.description: The artifact at fault — a path, or a unit id on PR-23.

owner.description: The skill that owns the remedy, e.g. inspire-domain.

derive_class.description: Derive's own class id on a PR-01; null on every other code.

components.description: stack.md's ## Test infrastructure, sorted by name.

probe_profiles.description: Resolved framework profiles carrying a probe recipe. Empty with components declared is PR-22.

worktree_recipe.description: stack.md's ## Worktree recipe, verbatim and never sorted — the order is the recipe. Empty with components declared is PR-24.

wireConventions.description: Transport decisions a spawned tester must assert rather than invent.

ids.description: The wire_conventions: frontmatter ids. Empty is legal, not a finding.

decisions.description: The ## Wire conventions rows, in file order.

refusal.description: Exit 4. A precondition of planning failed, so there is no waves or floor key at all — an empty key would read as 'planned, and it is empty'. Every class found is reported, not the first.

remedy.description: Refusals carry no owner: there is no unit for a skill to own.
